x.Innovation & R&D in Smoke Control: Investment in developing advanced smoke control technologies, such as smart controls, energy-efficient designs, and integration with building management systems. Evidence: patents, R&D centers, new product launches.
x.Manufacturing & Quality Assurance: Production capabilities and quality control processes ensuring consistent product quality and scalability. Evidence: manufacturing facilities, ISO certifications, lean practices, defect rates.
x.Compliance with Indian & Global Standard: Adherence to Indian fire safety codes (e.g., NBC, IS standards) and international standards (e.g., UL, EN). Evidence: certifications, test approvals, compliance documentation.
